findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quote_classic_pergola, quote_modern_classic_pergola, quote_curved_pergola, quote_lattice_panel, search_pergola_knowledge · Private data: create_contact_link, search_pergola_knowledge, report_pergola_problem · Public sink: search_pergola_faq.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quote_classic_pergola, quote_modern_classic_pergola, quote_curved_pergola, quote_lattice_panel, search_pergola_knowledge · Private data: create_contact_link, search_pergola_knowledge, report_pergola_problem · Public sink: search_pergola_faq

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
